title: Eddie Hill and his Bostonians at the Bluebird Ballroom
summary: He joined trumpeter Eddie Hill's eight-piece band at Shawnee's Bluebird Ballroom, with the Gray Brothers and Lester Taylor; Hill and Taylor wrote arrangements.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Which group is this?
This was Eddie Hill.
Oh, yeah.
Eddie Hill and his Bostonians and there was nobody in there from Boston.
(Laughter.)
And what town was that?
That was Shawnee, Oklahoma. And we were playing there to an old ballroom that had been there for years. Benny Moten and all the guys used to play there, you

know? Bluebird Ballroom. And so we played there, I think it was either three or four nights a week and then sometimes we'd play a dance for one of those small towns or something like that and that went along up until some fellow came from Albuquerque, New Mexico, looking for a band, you know. Of course, --
How many pieces was this band?
Huh?
How many pieces --
had about eight or nine-piece band.
And you said some different guys were playing in that band, the one that you said Lester and --
Other band.
Well, no, this wasn't the band that Lester played. That was Art Bronson's band that Lester --
Oh, I see.
-- and a lot of -- he had a lot of good musicians.
Anybody we'd know in Eddie Hill's band?
Well, yes, the Gray Brothers that had worked for Lee Deere, they was in Eddie's band. And let me see now, who else was in that band? And Lester Taylor, he was in that band.
What did he play?
He played saxophone. That was his mother's house I was staying at, raiding the ice box.
(Laughter.)
Oh, he had about eight-piece band and so we got this chance to go to Albuquerque, New Mexico.
What would this band have been playing mostly? Stocks or --
Well, they were playing stocks, but then Eddie could arrange.
Oh.
He could arrange. He could write and arrange.
What was his instrument, Eddie Hill's?
Trumpet.
Oh.

And he was the guy that had been on the shows, you know, old show musicians and run a lot of good show musicians. He had been with So then he could write and then this Lester Taylor was doing some writing, you know.
Well, could most of the guys in this band read all right?
Well, they could spell fairly good, the spelling, you know, because between Lester and Eddie, they could get them through it and once they got them through it,
they had it, you know, and that's how the band moved along, you know, and so we all loaded up and went out to Albuquerque.
